enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fan is running. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Fan continues running. Sleep. Turn to other side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Fan continues running.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and taking a quick cool shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Turn off fan. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Pick up soap. Rub soap on hands. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle and eating breakfast before the day heats up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Pick up kettle. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch to boil. Open refrigerator. Take out food items. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Wait for kettle to boil. Kettle switches off. Pour hot water into cup. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink tea. Stand up. Pick up bowl and cup. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and cup. Place in dish rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in light work clothes and packing a bag and water bottle for the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open bag. Place water bottle in bag. Place phone in bag. Place wallet in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit office during the morning peak
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of apartment. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office as a community program coordinator, running program planning, partner calls and participant coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email program. Read emails. Type replies. Make phone call to partner. Discuss program planning. Write notes. Call participant. Confirm attendance. Update spreadsheet. Print documents. Walk to printer. Pick up documents. Walk back to desk. File documents. Eat lunch. Walk to break room. Heat lunch in microwave. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Continue working. Check messages. Organize files. Prepare for next day. Shut down computer. Leave office.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home in the extreme heat after finishing work
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter apartment. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Freshening up and cooling down with a splash of water after the hot commute
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Splash water on face. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a light dinner with the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out protein. Close refrigerator. Place ingredients on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Chop protein. Turn on range hood. Place pot on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Pour oil into pot. Add ingredients. Stir. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Turn off range hood. Pick up plate. Serve food onto plate. Place plate on table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply dish soap. Pick up plate. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in dish rack. Pick up utensils. Scrub utensils. Rinse utensils. Place in dish rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Rinse cloth. Hang cloth. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on to escape the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on air conditioner. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Put down drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room and running the vacuum cleaner over the floor
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up items from floor. Place items on shelf. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum cleaner. Push vacuum across floor. Vacuum under sofa. Vacuum corners. Turn off vacuum cleaner. Unplug vacuum cleaner. Wrap cord. Place vacuum cleaner in closet. Pick up cloth. Wipe coffee table. Place cloth in kitchen. Turn off light. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Open drawer. Take out pajamas. Close drawer. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking phone messages and reading in bed with the fan on to wind down
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Type reply. Send reply. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Read. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn on fan. Lie down. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan running
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Fan running. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping. Fan continues running. Sleep. Turn to other side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Fan continues running. Sleep.
